name: Introduction to AI & Machine Learning
summary: A gentle first tour of what AI and machine learning are, how machines learn from data, and where AI is used today, assuming only high-school maths.

topics.name: What is artificial intelligence? Definitions and everyday examples
A short history: from Turing and Dartmouth to deep learning and ChatGPT
How machines learn: data, features, models and predictions
Supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning in plain terms
A first model by hand: fitting a line and drawing a decision boundary
Training, testing and why models make mistakes (overfitting in pictures)
Neural networks and deep learning, intuitively
Generative AI and chatbots: what large language models do
Robots and embodied AI: sense, think, act
Hands-on without code: Teachable Machine, notebooks and chat assistants
Limits, bias and societal impact of AI
Careers and learning paths in AI, ML and robotics
